features.name: 3-axis gimbal stabilization
features.notes: Counteracts vehicle rotation using IMU data, supports zyx/zxy Euler conventions

features.name: Gimbal command angle tracking
features.notes: Tracks desired roll/pitch/yaw angles from gimbal_command_rpy_deg topic

features.name: Multi-agent parametric launch
features.notes: Spawns per-vehicle gimbal nodes from vehicles.yaml + gimbal_config.yaml

features.name: World-frame LOS rate gimbal controller
features.notes: Ports iris_ma6 analytical gimbal controller to ROS2. Accepts normalized az/el rate commands, integrates in world frame, computes body-frame joints via IK. Multi-agent launch via multi_agent_los_rate.launch.py

features.name: Fixed (non-gimballed) camera mount
features.notes: MAS ticket 055. Constant-pose stand-in for the real interceptor's rigidly bolted camera (forward, 30.8 deg UP, no zoom hardware): publishes the constant isaac_joint_commands plus the two constants the field stack shims onto the wire (gimbal_state_rpy_deg, camera/zoom_level), and deliberately NOT camera/zoom_level_cmd (it drives MonocularCamera.set_zoom, which rebuilds focal length as mean(fx,fy) and miscalibrates a non-square-pixel camera). Replaces los_rate_controller in the fixed-camera session; multi_agent_fixed_mount.launch.py, namespaces:= selects which vehicles. Wire contract verified on a live ROS graph. IN PROGRESS because AC3/AC4 (does the Isaac articulation actually hold the pose, and how much does the PD drive deflect in flight) need a running Isaac session — gimbal_mount_deflection_deg is the instrument for that. 2026-08-15 (cont.): added the ticket 055 D2 consistency guards — _check_boot_label (reads fixed_camera_vehicles out of /tmp/isaac_boot_label.json, requires /proc/<pid> alive so a stale label authorises nothing, RAISES if this vehicle is not listed) and _check_command_contention (ERRORs if a second publisher appears on isaac_joint_commands, i.e. a los_rate_controller overlapping the fixed set). Added config/vehicles_gimballed.yaml for the complement of a mixed session.

features.name: Fixed-camera SITL session (cross-package)
features.notes: MAS ticket 055. This package supplies fixed_mount_publisher + multi_agent_fixed_mount.launch.py + config/vehicles_gimballed.yaml; the rest of the session lives outside it — PegasusSimulator/launch/px4_multi_world_iris_fixedcam.isaac.py (authors the fTheta fisheye, fail-closed readback), ros2_ws/src/sim_camera_relay (960->720 squeeze + rebuilt camera_info under the field's topic names), and IsaacPX4/tmux/isaac_sim_fixedcam.tmuxp.yaml. All code written and unit-verified offline; IN PROGRESS until the session is booted — ticket 055 AC1-AC6 all need a running Isaac.
